Every value here was measured or derived MODEL-FREE at registration, before any contact: the composed and protocol hashes through core.config.compose / core.config.protocol_hash, the Solver fragment seed through rails.runner._solver_fragment_seed, the roster facts from the committed DEV-2000-ADDED roster receipt's own items, the split identities through data.splits.split_identity_hash, and the DEV-2000-ADDED artifact pins copied verbatim out of the sealed DEV-2000-ADDED plan baseline. accounting.ceiling_arithmetic: 19,000 = 1,000 DEV-2000-ADDED rows x 19 and 76 = 4 rows x 19, where 19 is the grouped-Solver graph's OWN ceiling at samples 5 as rails.native_episode_config.load_native_episode_config resolves it: perception.max_iterations + (max_revisions + 1) x (solver.max_iterations x solver.samples + reviewer.max_iterations + planner.max_iterations) = 1 + 2 x (1 x 5 + 3 + 1) = 19. Verified offline at registration by the dry run: the composed program phase-native-candidates-review-revise-samples5-v1 declares max_contacts 19 and the loader's own graph ceiling resolves to 19 (a disagreement is refused by name). FIT: 76,000 = 19,000 x (1 speech packet + 3 endpoints) and 304 = 76 x 4 -- cell ROLL-1's own native_contact_fit mode and multiplier, rescaled to this roster.

expected_cost.note: About 8.5 contacts per row, so about 8,550 contacts and about 3.3 GPU hours on the arm. Basis: cell ROLL-1 MEASURED 8.5504 contacts per row on this exact grouped-Solver form (samples 5, temperature 0.7, min_support 3) over 625 R01C rows, and cell ROLL-2 flew the same form today on TRAIN Fold A at 8,996 contacts over 1,080 rows (8.33 per row); nothing in this registration changes the role graph, the prompt form or the number of scheduled requests -- only the roster the same form runs on. 8.5 x 1,000 = 8,500 and 8.5504 x 1,000 = 8,550, so the registered ceiling of 19,000 is about 2.2x the expectation and the 11.2 GPU-hour ceiling about 3.4x it (11.2 = cell ROLL-2's 12.0 x 1,000 / 1,080 = 11.11, rounded up to one decimal: ROLL-2's own cap at this roster's size). A ceiling is a BOUND, never a target, and budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.

measurement_design.no_comparison_sentence: This cell makes no comparison: it is an ASSET. It flies one arm and one arm only, has no comparator cell, no paired contrast and no gate number, so expected_effect_pp is 0.0 with claims_benefit false. Its deliverable is the sealed five-sample pool itself, over which later actions become computable offline at about 0.53 pp at n = 1,000 and at zero GPU cost.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-3-DEV2000-ADDED-S.note: The four-row structural form smoke of ROLL-3 proves FORM and nothing else: five custodied Solver samples per row, the plurality-commit replay, zero native task-contract calls, every request fitting. It is scored by no one and read by no one, and under docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 3 rule 5 a batch of four rows can never be evidence of benefit.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-3-DEV2000-ADDED-V.note: ROLL-3 makes no effectiveness claim of its own: it seals a 1,000-row x 5-sample pool on DEV-2000-ADDED so that commit, selection and verification rules can be read offline at about the 0.67 pp floor of docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2c (about 0.53 pp at n = 1,000), on the evaluation roster where every admitted policy must later be replicated. Any benefit claim belongs to the read over this pool, which declares its own block; that read reports intent accuracy beside SLU-F1 (owner decisions 133 and 137).

measurement_design.why_offline_sealed_pool: The measurement instrument note docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md establishes that a cross-flight contrast at this scale carries a measured +1.87 pp A/A offset (two request-identical flights differed by +1.87 pp SLU with a CI95 excluding zero while intent moved -1.28 pp; on this very roster the B6 pair measured -0.25 pp), so such a contrast needs an in-chain A/A replicate and about 3 pp of effect. The only sub-1 pp instrument the program has is an offline read over one sealed sample pool, and that pool exists on R01C and TRAIN Fold A but NOT on DEV-2000-ADDED. This cell creates the missing pool.
